title: kb-harvest capture metadata
description: The machine half of one raw capture (<slug>.capture.json). Structural facts only — the agnostic knowledge itself lives in the sibling <slug>.md. Nothing here reproduces copyrighted body text.

slug.description: Candidate slug — the ledger's slug (usually the URL's last path segment); the capture folder name and filename stem.

sourceId.description: The ledger source this candidate came from (a sources/*.json id, or a GitHub owner/repo slug).

sourceUrls.description: Every URL the capture drew from — the candidate page first, plus any same-topic continuation pages.

hop.description: 0 = the page lives on the source itself; 1 = reached by following one curated link from a link hub. There is no hop 2.

capturedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp passed via --captured-at, or the literal string "unknown".

triage.description: Captures exist only for NEW candidates — EXISTS candidates are handed to kb-intake as bare URLs.

evidence.description: Product/brand implementations displaced from the body by the agnosticism rule — deliberately in kb.mjs wild item shape so kb-intake can carry them into an "In the wild" block (still subject to its anti-fabrication bar).

note.description: One line: what of the pattern this product implements.

diagrams.description: Provenance for every re-drawn mermaid diagram in the .md — never a copy of source diagram code.

redrawnFrom.description: URL of the source figure (page or asset).

type.description: What the source figure was before re-drawing.
